standouts.head: Sitting on stacked support
standouts.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.
standouts.text: Price sits on the September breakout level, the Sep 3 high and the 20-day average: 3 kinds of level at one price.

standouts.head: Uptrend on every average
standouts.learn: Higher highs and higher lows, with price above rising averages.
standouts.text: Price is above its rising 50-day and 200-day averages, and the 50-day is above the 200-day.

standouts.head: Buyers stepping in earlier
standouts.learn: Price makes a higher low while momentum makes a lower low: buyers stepped in earlier, a common sign the uptrend resumes.
standouts.text: Price made a higher low on Oct 1 while 5 of 7 momentum gauges made a lower low (hidden bullish divergence).

standouts.head: A possible double bottom
standouts.learn: Two lows at the same level with a peak between; a close above the peak confirms it.
standouts.text: It bottomed twice at the same level (Sep 9 and Oct 1); a close above the peak between them confirms the double bottom.

standouts.head: MACD just turned up
standouts.learn: The gap between a fast and a slow average of price; crossing above its signal line means momentum is turning up.
standouts.text: MACD crossed above its signal line on Oct 12, above zero: momentum renewing in the trend's direction.

SPNT.take: SPNT: it is in an uptrend on every average, and it sits on support at the September breakout level and the Sep 3 high. Buyers are stepping in earlier, and there is a possible double bottom. This is the kind of setup the desk wants to own.
